_meta.title: Private Floor Club verification benchmark cases
_meta.groundTruthNote: GROUND TRUTH TO BE CONFIRMED BY RICHARD. Person-to-company links and titles for REAL cases are the benchmark author's public-knowledge assumptions. They are NOT verified and the harness never asserts a current job title. Cases marked companyOnly only expect company corroboration.

defaults.statement: I invest in and operate commercial and residential real estate and would like to meet other owners and operators.

_meta.emailPolicy: Every case uses a Gmail address (except F02 which is a disposable mailinator address on purpose, and the QA cases which use qa-test-*@privatefloorclub.com so the QA prefix gate can run) so the email domain carries no signal. Nothing is ever sent to these addresses.
